verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since an LLM observability platform could plausibly surface AI-generated insights or suggestions about logged traffic. However, the evidence shows only dashboards, alerts and reports, HQL querying, and webhooks. The webhook-driven 'real-time evaluation' is something users build externally on registered callbacks, not built-in AI insights or suggestions. No evidence shows the product generating AI insights or recommendations from user data inside the UI.
